title: Loan flat charge 19.8 (USD, 0 dp, multiples 1) rounds up to 20
scenario: Create a flat (chargeCalculationType=1) loan charge of 19.80 on a 10,000 loan whose product has digitsAfterDecimal=0 and inMultiplesOf=1, and read the persisted charge amount back.
grade: Compute the flat charge amount with the product rounding rule (0 dp, fraction <= 0.5 rounds DOWN, else UP, then round up to the nearest in_multiples_of) and assert charge_amount_minor == 20.
